spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (चोलयति)
1 To rise, to increase.
2 To raise, to elevate.
2 To dip or dive into.

r. 1st cl. (चुल्लति)
1 To manifest one's meaning.
2 To dally, to wanton or coquet.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
Blear-eyed.
m. (-ल्लः)
A blear eye.
f. (-ल्ली)
1 A chimney, a fire place.
2 A funeral pile.
E.
चुल्ल to indicate meaning, affix अच्; or नि preposition, लच् affix implying moisture of the eyes, and चुल् substituted for नि.

f. (-ला)
1 An upper room, a room on the top of a house.
2 A crest.
E.
चुल to rise, affixes अङ् and टाप्: see चूडा.

m. (-कः)
1 Mud, mire.
2 A small vessel or pot, a gallipot, &c.
3 The hand hollowed to hold water.
n. (-कं)
Water in which pulse has been steeped.
E.
चुल to dip into, affix क्वुन्: see चलुक.

m. (-की)
A porpoise.
E.
चुलुक mud, इनि aff.

r. 1st cl. (चुलम्पति)
1 To cut.
2 To disappear, to be lost.

m. (-म्पः)
Fondling or nursing children, &c.
f. (-म्पा)
A she goat.
E.
चुलुम्प to cut, अच् and टाप् affs.

m. (-म्पी)
The gangetic porpoise.
E.
चुलुम्प to cut, इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
The palm of the hand hollowed as if to hold water.

f. (-की)
1 A porpoise.
2 A water pot.
3 The opposite bank of a river.
E.
चुल्ल to dally, (in the water,) क्वुन् affix, and fem. affix ङीष्.

f. (-ल्लिः)
A fire place, a chimney.
E.
चुल्ल to manifest meaning, and इ aff.

f. (-का)
1 The root of an elephant's ear.
2 The body of a drama, the inferior personages of the drama collectively.
n. (-कं)
Flour cakes fried with ghee.
E.
चूल to be or make high, affix ण्वुल्.
